1.note: The PAID base reel spin (CostCredits=1000>0, full reel fields, sum(PayoutIdToWinAmount)==WinCredits on 80,000/80,000 rounds). 402 rounds carry ReMarks='Trigger Wheel' + payid 666 (pays 0 credits) — the wheel-feature trigger (same trigger-marker shape as M15 ST1 pid 666). Field signature matches the VALIDATED ST1/ST35 paid_spin/Normal -> strict-reuse the 4 generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins (no new code).

2.note: The Wheel collect settlement (ReMarks='WheelSpin CellIndex N; WheelId 1;', StopSymbolsByCol degenerate ['NULL','NULL','NULL'], WinCredits settles, NO PayoutIdToWinAmount and no BetAmount). Field signature EXACT-MATCHES the VALIDATED ST2 settlement/Wheel (M279/M283) -> STRICT-REUSE the wheel_dynamics plugin (already play-keyed to 'Wheel' in machine_spec) + the M43/M279 SynthesizePayIdRule precedent. State machine (verified 402 triggers): each ST1 'Trigger Wheel' opens a wheel block of 2-4 ST2 spins (mean 2.35); intermediate ST2 win 0 (advance/preview), the LAST ST2 settles (402 triggers -> exactly 402 winning last-ST2, the only real wheel win; 543 non-winning ST2 are previews). NO native payid -> needs synth (m203_wheel_settlement) so sum(payid)==summary and _unattributed_st2 -> 0.

136.note: A bare STATE marker round (ReMarks='WheelSelector'; no win field at all, no reel fields). Emitted between ST2 wheel spins inside the wheel block (the wheel-cell selector step). FeatureWin key 'WheelSelector'. 543/543 rounds carry no win. Manifest-only; no per-ST plugin (the generic PER_SPINTYPE plugins handle the empty-state histogram).

137.note: A STATE marker round (ReMarks='PreWheel ReqCommonParam'; carries a WinCredits field that is 0 on 100% of 543 rounds — a preview/marker, NOT a real win, must count 0). No reel fields, no payid. Emitted between ST2 wheel spins (the pre-wheel parameter request step). FeatureWin key 'PreWheel'. Manifest-only; no per-ST plugin.

trigger.note: ST1 round-level wheel trigger: payid 666 + ReMarks='Trigger Wheel' (pays 0 credits, opens the Wheel feature) on 402/80,000 paid spins. Same trigger-marker shape as M15 ST1 pid 666. The Wheel (ST2) is the collect settlement; ST136 (WheelSelector) + ST137 (PreWheel) are interstitial state markers.

FeatureWin taxonomy (double-decoded analysisResult): Normal/Wheel/WheelSelector/PreWheel — matches the per-ST plays exactly.
